t: This is Marlborough Fine Art, a commercial art gallery. It was founded in London in 1946 by two art dealers, Harry Fischer and Frank Lloyd, and both of them went on to own it. Fischer was an Austrian-British dealer, and Lloyd ran the gallery for many years. The firm grew well beyond this city. In 1963 it opened a gallery in Manhattan, and later it added spaces in Madrid and Barcelona. So you're standing at the starting point of a gallery that eventually reached three countries.
